WITH exam_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    ID,
    COUNT(*) as exam_count
  FROM Examination
  GROUP BY ID
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    ID,
    exam_count,
    SUM(exam_count) OVER () as total_exams,
    COUNT(*) OVER () as num_groups,
    CAST(exam_count AS REAL) / SUM(exam_count) OVER () as fraction,
    1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () as avg_fraction
  FROM exam_counts
)
SELECT 
  ID,
  exam_count,
  fraction,
  fraction - avg_fraction as excess
FROM stats
WHERE fraction > avg_fraction
ORDER BY excess DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Window functions (SUM OVER, COUNT OVER) are supported by the target SQL dialect
The average fraction is computed as the arithmetic mean of all group fractions, which equals 1/n where n is the number of groups (including any NULL-ID group)
